sonnet.problem: Hebrews 9:2-5 is a stretch of tabernacle furnishings and contents, which is a list of building-plan detail. The walkthrough gives it two story cards (cards 2 and 4) and a choice card (card 3) that asks what was inside the ark. A long stretch gets one summary card and no choice card, and choice cards never ask about contents or names.
sonnet.rule: Papa Dorin sums up the stretch in one story card. ... A long stretch never gets a choice card.
